items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Fulco played in Cobbs straight on for...

ctx.x: Well they worked at Cobbs. At Cobbs, yeah. On a couple of different occasions. I don't remember. They started out in the late teens working at Cobbs. I don't remember.
Johnny Peretti. Yeah, he worked in there during the carnival season. It wasn't a steady job through that. I mean I don't... Now Cobbs, when they started... Fulco played in Cobbs straight on for...
Well he was in Cobbs with Sandy and... Yeah, with Sandy and Joe Schultz and...
